name: frt_debt_charges_pct_revenues
source: History: FRT 2025 (Fiscal Reference Tables, October 2025), Table 13 ('Public debt charges'), published 'Gross public debt charges as a percentage of revenues' column. Forecast: PBO Economic and Fiscal Outlook - June 2026 (RP-2627-002-S), Table 2 'Summary of the fiscal outlook' debt-service ratio.
source_label: DoF Fiscal Reference Tables 2025; PBO June 2026 EFO (forecast)
is_forecast_note: is_forecast=0 means FRT 2025 Table 13 actual (FY1983-84 to FY2024-25). is_forecast=1 means PBO EFO June 2026 projection (FY2025-26 to FY2030-31). PBO-stated values for FY2025-26 (10.6) and FY2030-31 (13.1); intermediate years derived from EFO Table 2 levels (public debt charges $B / revenues $B); the derivation reproduces all PBO-stated values exactly.
concept_note: Gross public debt charges as % of total budgetary revenues -- the federal 'carrying cost' / debt-service ratio. PBO's EFO 'debt service ratio (public debt charges relative to total revenues)' is the same concept: PBO's FY2024-25 row (53.4/511.0 = 10.5%) equals the FRT Table 13 actual exactly, so there is NO seam at the actual/forecast boundary. Do NOT mix with the monthly fiscal-monitor debt_service_ratio series (YTD in-year ratio, starts Feb 2022).
key_points_note: 1990s peak: FY1990-91 at 37.6%. Series low: FY2021-22 at 5.9%. Last actual: FY2024-25 at 10.5%. PBO forecast rises to 13.1% by FY2030-31.

basis_break.description: Full accrual accounting introduced FY1983-84. FRT Table 13 extends back to FY1966-67 but the FRT footnote states pre-1983-84 data are not directly comparable; series starts at FY1983-84 consistent with the other FRT series in this module.

verification_note: Table 13 ratio column cross-checked against FRT Table 1 levels (gross PDC $M / revenues $M) for FY1983-84, FY1990-91, FY1995-96, FY1997-98, FY2020-21, FY2024-25 -- all reproduce to 0.1pp (2026-06-10). PBO PDF cached at data/raw/fiscal/pbo_efo_june2026.pdf.
